findings.title: MiewIDNoseExtractor runtime input size 160×160 vs ONNX expected 440×440
findings.evidence: ONNX input shape=[batch,3,440,440]; runtime default input_size=160, resize to 160×160. Embedding computed on distorted input.
findings.expected: Runtime input size must match ONNX export size (440×440)
findings.actual: Input resized to 160×160 before inference. 5.3% of expected pixel count.
findings.impact: Nose channel produces degraded embeddings. Invalidates any experiment using this channel.
findings.root_cause: input_size default 160 chosen arbitrarily; ONNX exported at 440×440
findings.minimal_fix: Change MiewIDNoseExtractor default input_size=440

findings.title: MiewID ONNX uses default timm AvgPool instead of official GeM(p=3) pooling
findings.evidence: Official modeling_miewid.py line: self.backbone.global_pool = GeM(). Our wrapper keeps timm default SelectAdaptivePool2d(pool_type='avg').
findings.expected: GeM pooling (p=3, learnable) before BN and L2 norm per official architecture
findings.actual: AvgPool+Flatten used. Architecture differs from official.
findings.impact: MiewID channel uses approximate architecture. Cosine parity with official model UNVERIFIED.
findings.root_cause: download_models.py does not replicate official GeM pooling replacement
findings.minimal_fix: Replace backbone.global_pool with GeM(p=3) before exporting

findings.title: MiewID-msv3 is a general wildlife re-ID model misclassified as 'nose' channel
findings.evidence: Official model card: '64 wildlife species — fins, flukes, flanks, faces.' No mention of nose prints.
findings.expected: Channel named 'appearance' or 'wildlife_reid', not 'nose'
findings.actual: Treated as nose-print specialist. Channel semantics are misleading.
findings.impact: Channel ablation results misinterpreted. Users believe nose-print identification is active.
findings.root_cause: Historical design: MiewID repurposed without updating naming
findings.minimal_fix: Rename module to evidence/miewid.py, class to MiewIDReidExtractor, channel type to 'wildlife_reid'

findings.title: TinyViTBackbone is a 3-layer CNN with random weights, named 'TinyViT'
findings.evidence: 3×Conv2d → BN → ReLU → AvgPool → Linear. No attention, no checkpoint.
findings.expected: If named TinyViT, should use mobile ViT architecture.
findings.actual: 3-layer random CNN in _BACKBONE_REGISTRY. Output is random noise.
findings.impact: If 'tinyvit' backbone enabled, enrollment stores random embeddings. Index corrupted.
findings.root_cause: Placeholder never replaced with real TinyViT
findings.minimal_fix: Rename to ExperimentalUntrainedCNN. Remove from _BACKBONE_REGISTRY.

findings.title: DNPMask UNet initializes once (not per-call) with random weights
findings.evidence: self._model = self._build_unet() called once in __init__. Repeated apply() calls reuse same untrained instance.
findings.expected: Nose mask should have trained weight file or be removed
findings.actual: Random UNet applied to every nose crop. Actively destroys signal.
findings.impact: Any pipeline using DNPMask corrupts input images.
findings.root_cause: Placeholder created without checkpoints, not disabled for production
findings.minimal_fix: Add guard that skips mask when no checkpoint exists

findings.title: LandmarkEvidencer default constructor creates random HRNetHeatmap + GNN
findings.evidence: LandmarkEvidencer() with no arguments creates HRNetHeatmap() (random 5-conv CNN) and LandmarkGraphEmbedder() (random GNN).
findings.expected: LandmarkEvidencer should require trained model artifact
findings.actual: Random heatmap + random GNN. Output has no identity information.
findings.impact: If 'landmark' channel enabled, every enrollment/query adds random noise.
findings.root_cause: Placeholder code. SuperAnimal PT (112 MB) exists but ONNX is dummy wrapper.
findings.minimal_fix: Require non-None models. Add warning when random weights used.

findings.title: SuperAnimal ONNX export ignores checkpoint — exports newly initialized replacement
findings.evidence: _HRNetWrapper.__init__(self, state_dict) accepts state_dict but never applies it. The torch.load result (line 107) is discarded.
findings.expected: ONNX should represent the official SuperAnimal HRNet-W32 checkpoint
findings.actual: Newly initialized replacement exported. Graph represents a 3-layer CNN with random weights.
findings.impact: SuperAnimal-based landmark extraction produces random keypoints.
findings.root_cause: state_dict loaded but never used. Wrapper constructor ignores the parameter.
findings.minimal_fix: Load real checkpoint into an actual HRNet architecture, then export

findings.title: Evaluator always reports rank1=0 (missing metric key)
findings.evidence: compute_metrics() returned dict without 'rank1' key. Main always got default 0.
findings.expected: Evaluation returns valid retrieval metrics (Rank-1, mAP) or separate protocols
findings.actual: FIXED: verification/retrieval/open-set protocols implemented with distinct metric suites.
findings.impact: Resolved by G1 evaluator correction.
findings.root_cause: compute_metrics computed verification metrics (AUC, EER) but main expected retrieval metrics (rank1)
findings.minimal_fix: Implement separate verification/retrieval/open-set protocols with correct metric suites.

findings.title: PerChannelCalibrator uses pickle for serialization
findings.evidence: pickle.dump(self._calibrators, f) on line 35. pickle.load(f) on line 41.
findings.expected: Serialization should use safe format (JSON, npz, safetensors)
findings.actual: pickle used for calibrator state.
findings.impact: Arbitrary code execution during deserialization if calibrator file is tampered with.
findings.root_cause: pickle used for convenience
findings.minimal_fix: Replace with JSON or numpy .npz format

findings.title: Uncertainty values are fabricated constants from pipeline
findings.evidence: pipeline assigns uncertainty=0.05 for MiewID/Landmark, 0.1 for generic channels. DINOv2 returns genuine 0.0 fallback.
findings.expected: Uncertainty should be computed from model output
findings.actual: DINOv2 returns 0.0. Pipeline assigns fabricated constants. Open-set rejection is fixed cosine threshold.
findings.impact: Uncertainty-aware open-set claim is unsupported.
findings.root_cause: No trained evidential head.
findings.minimal_fix: Remove uncertainty from open-set until real uncertainty estimation implemented.

findings.title: CVI API accepts only PIL Image; video input not supported
findings.evidence: Type annotations: image: Image.Image only. No video path or frame iterator. TemporalAggregator not wired into API.
findings.expected: Video input should be supported or documentation corrected
findings.actual: Only single-image enrollment/search supported
findings.impact: README examples claiming video support are false.
findings.root_cause: TemporalAggregator not integrated into CVI public API
findings.minimal_fix: Update README to 'image-only' or add video method

findings.title: MiewID-msv3 license is UNVERIFIED
findings.evidence: HF API: license file GET → 404. cardData license field absent.
findings.expected: Production model must have clear license
findings.actual: UNVERIFIED — insufficient data to determine license status
findings.impact: Cannot distribute or deploy MiewID commercially without legal review
findings.root_cause: Upstream model repo does not declare license in standard locations
findings.minimal_fix: Inspect upstream repo and config files for license terms.

findings.title: Three FAISS index implementations: canonical not established
findings.evidence: identity/gpu_index.py is byte-for-byte duplicate of gpu_index.py.
findings.expected: Single canonical index with documented capabilities
findings.actual: Multiple implementations. CVI API uses SpeciesFilteredIndex.
findings.impact: Maintenance burden.
findings.root_cause: Evolutionary without deprecation
findings.minimal_fix: Add deprecation warnings, remove duplicate and .bak file.

findings.title: Sequential 60/20/20 split — leakage risk from file-order dependency
findings.evidence: Previous code: return pairs[:n_train], pairs[n_train:n_train+n_cal], pairs[...]. Leakage risk from file-order dependency.
findings.expected: Explicit calibration/test files with leakage validation
findings.actual: FIXED: calibration-pairs and test-pairs required as separate files; validate_split_disjoint() checks paths, identities, video/session groups, reversed pairs.
findings.impact: Resolved by G1 evaluator correction.
findings.root_cause: Convenience slicing instead of explicit split assignment
findings.minimal_fix: Remove split_pairs(). Require explicit files.

findings.title: Validation loop applies CrossEntropy to embedding (not logits)
findings.evidence: Line 525: logits = model(images, labels) in eval mode → returns embedding (not logits). Line 526: F.cross_entropy(logits, labels) applied to embedding.
findings.expected: Validation loss should be computed on class logits or retrieval metric
findings.actual: CrossEntropy applied to 384-d embedding. Best checkpoint selection is invalid.
findings.impact: Cannot trust any training run's model selection.
findings.root_cause: forward() returns embedding when not training; validation loop expects logits
findings.minimal_fix: Add forward_train(images, labels) returning logits. Use in training.

findings.title: TAR@FAR selection uses valid[-1] from ascending linspace → always TAR=0
findings.evidence: old code: valid = np.where(fpr_curve <= target_far)[0]; tar = tpr_curve[valid[-1]]. valid[-1] selects threshold=1.0 where no scores qualify, TAR=0.
findings.expected: Maximum TAR among thresholds satisfying FAR constraint
findings.actual: FIXED: score-derived thresholds, select_threshold_at_far() picks max TAR from valid set.
findings.impact: Resolved. Regression test verifies old returns 0, new returns correct TAR.
findings.root_cause: valid[-1] on ascending threshold array picks most restrictive threshold
findings.minimal_fix: Use score-derived thresholds, max-TAR argmax selection

findings.title: Sequential split slicing — leakage risk
findings.evidence: return pairs[:n_train], pairs[n_train:n_train+n_cal], pairs[n_train+n_cal:]
findings.expected: Explicit split files with leakage validation
findings.actual: FIXED: calibration-pairs and test-pairs required; validate_split_disjoint() checks 10+ grouping fields.
findings.impact: Resolved.
findings.root_cause: Convenience slicing order-dependent
findings.minimal_fix: Require explicit split file arguments

findings.title: Raw similarity treated as calibrated probability (ECE invalid)
findings.evidence: Old compute_calibration_metrics(sims, labels) treated raw cosine similarity as probability.
findings.expected: ECE/Brier/NLL computed on valid probabilities in [0,1]
findings.actual: FIXED: compute_probability_calibration_metrics() validates [0,1], adds Brier+NLL. fit_isotonic_calibration() fits on calibration split, transforms test scores.
findings.impact: Resolved. Calibration metrics now accept only probabilities.
findings.root_cause: No probability contract validation
findings.minimal_fix: Rename, validate input range, add Brier+NLL, wire isotonic fitting

findings.title: Hardcoded pinned commit instead of dynamic git metadata
findings.evidence: pinned_commit = '0ba3b1b...' hardcoded.
findings.expected: Report identifies the code that actually generated it
findings.actual: FIXED: dynamic git rev-parse HEAD, branch, dirty state, timestamps, Python/NumPy versions.
findings.impact: Resolved.
findings.root_cause: Hardcoded for reproducibility without dynamic fallback
findings.minimal_fix: Add _git_commit(), _git_branch(), _git_dirty() functions

findings.title: No open-set evaluation protocol
findings.evidence: Prior commit had no open-set module.
findings.expected: Known-vs-unknown AUROC, AUPR, DIR@FPIR
findings.actual: FIXED: evaluate_open_set() with AUROC, AUPR, DIR@FPIR, false accept/reject counts.
findings.impact: Resolved. OSCR deferred pending IJS validation.
findings.root_cause: Not implemented in original scoping
findings.minimal_fix: Implement evaluate_open_set() with standard open-set metrics

findings.title: No retrieval mINP metric
findings.evidence: Prior commit had no mINP implementation.
findings.expected: mINP reported alongside mAP
findings.actual: FIXED: mINP computed via penetration rate at correct results.
findings.impact: Resolved.
findings.root_cause: Not implemented in original scoping
findings.minimal_fix: Add _compute_ap_inp returning both AP and mINP

findings.title: No self-match exclusion for retrieval
findings.evidence: Prior commit had no self-match exclusion mechanism.
findings.expected: When query and gallery originate from same pool, identical sample must be excluded
findings.actual: FIXED: exclude_self bool mask parameter. Masks out self-similarity with -inf.
findings.impact: Resolved.
findings.root_cause: Not implemented
findings.minimal_fix: Add exclude_self parameter with -inf masking

findings.title: No confidence intervals on FAR/TAR
findings.evidence: Prior commit had no interval reporting.
findings.expected: Wilson intervals for FAR and TAR in report
findings.actual: FIXED: Wilson CI via wilson_rate, zero-event exact upper bound, required_zero_event_trials reported per operating point.
findings.impact: Resolved.
findings.root_cause: Not implemented
findings.minimal_fix: Wire _confidence_intervals using legacy wilson_rate helper

findings.title: Circular regression test oracles (trusts script output)
findings.evidence: Old test had 'trust the script' comments. Manual reasoning and script values conflicted.
findings.expected: All fixtures have independently derived ground truth
findings.actual: FIXED: all fixtures hand-derived with documented ranking, precision, AP, mINP, EER formulas.
findings.impact: Resolved.
findings.root_cause: Test fixtures designed without independent verification
findings.minimal_fix: Redesign all fixture values with explicit hand-computed oracles

findings.title: Retrieval rank_ks parameter ignored
findings.evidence: Prior code always used (1,5,10) regardless of top_k parameter.
findings.expected: rank_ks parameter controls which ranks are reported
findings.actual: FIXED: configurable rank_ks tuple drives Rank-k reporting.
findings.impact: Resolved.
findings.root_cause: Hardcoded rank constants
findings.minimal_fix: Accept rank_ks parameter, report only requested ranks

findings.title: Typed exceptions replaced with error-dict returns
findings.evidence: Prior code returned {'error': '...'} dictionary from core metric functions.
findings.expected: Typed exceptions for invalid inputs
findings.actual: FIXED: LengthMismatchError, InvalidLabelError, NonFiniteScoreError, EmptyInputError, SingleClassError, EvaluationError.
findings.impact: Resolved. CLI catches typed exceptions, writes error artifact, exits non-zero.
findings.root_cause: Error-dict pattern instead of exceptions
findings.minimal_fix: Define exception hierarchy, raise instead of returning error dicts

findings.title: Rounding inside core metric functions
findings.evidence: Prior code had round(d_prime, 4) inside core function.
findings.expected: Full precision preserved in core, rounding only in presentation
findings.actual: FIXED: no rounding in compute_verification_metrics. Full float64 precision returned.
findings.impact: Resolved.
findings.root_cause: Convenience rounding without separation of concerns
findings.minimal_fix: Remove all round() calls from core functions

findings.title: select_threshold_at_far returns sentinel -1 for sample counts
findings.evidence: OperatingThreshold constructed with calibration_num_negative=-1, calibration_false_accepts=-1. True counts not tracked through curve computation.
findings.expected: Sample counts and false accept/reject counts tracked from calibration data
findings.actual: Sentinel -1 values returned. Consumer must recompute from raw data.
findings.impact: Confidence intervals for calibration operating point may be wrong if consumers trust sentinel values.
findings.root_cause: VerificationCurve stores only rates, not counts
findings.minimal_fix: Add n_pos, n_neg fields to VerificationCurve or OperatingThreshold from input data

findings.title: OSCR not implemented in open_set.py
findings.evidence: Standard open-set metric OSCR (Open-Set Classification Rate) not implemented. Requires gallery threshold sweep and identification-vs-rejection curve.
findings.expected: OSCR reported when gallery has multiple samples per identity
findings.actual: Not implemented. DIR at specified FPIR included as partial substitute.
findings.impact: Cannot fully compare with open-set benchmarks that report OSCR.
findings.root_cause: Requires per-identity gallery statistics not validated in current input schema
findings.minimal_fix: Implement OSCR when gallery has ≥2 samples per identity; otherwise report as UNSUPPORTED

findings.title: CLI report schema v2 not independently validated against JSON Schema
findings.evidence: Schema version declared as cvi.evaluation.report.v2 but no formal schema file exists.
findings.expected: JSON Schema file that validates report output
findings.actual: Schema validated only by usage. Structural changes may silently break consumers.
findings.impact: Report structure changes may go undetected by downstream consumers.
findings.root_cause: Schema defined implicitly by code
findings.minimal_fix: Create schema file in configs/ or evaluation/ and validate at write time
